body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Patient golden retriever teacher; warm, sequential explanation, understanding before spectacle. Voice direction: Mature female alto with a soft Caribbean English accent, velvety resonance and relaxed rhythmic emphasis. Thoughtful and instructional, with clear unhurried connections between ideas. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
